title: personal.json sidebar_channels
description: The personal order of the posts of a forum, the person's own archive of a channel and the person's own pins of a channel and of posts in the sidebar (table user_channel_states, docs/spec/20-privacy.md section 5.2), archived channels included. Only channel and thread IDs, never a name or a title.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel the row belongs to.

thread_order.description: The personal order of the posts of the channel, as thread IDs; empty for the default order.

hidden_at.description: When the person archived the channel in the own sidebar; absent while it shows in the normal list.

pinned_at.description: When the person pinned the channel to the top of its space in the own sidebar; absent while it is not pinned.

pinned_threads.description: The posts of the channel the person pinned to the top of the forum, as thread IDs in pin order; empty for none.

updated_by_device_id.description: ID of the device of the last change; absent when unknown or the device is gone.

updated_at.description: When the row was last changed.
